comment: Definitely a stressful class. My poor test grades made me feel like I was not learning anything despite the hours of reading I did for his class.  I really disliked Van Meter during the first half of the semester mostly because of his poor lecture delivery, but he surely showed improvement.  The loads of extra credit he offered got me to an A.

Dr. Van Meter really wasn't that bad. This was his first time teaching, so of course he sucked in the beginning, but he definitely got better as the semester went on. His tests were difficult, but he gave a TON of extra credit -- I have an A test average now. He is a really nice guy, and definitely tried to improve successfully.
I wrote this rating during his class which explained why I wasn't functionally able to write a proper sentence.
